channel.title: South Africa - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from South Africa, every source cited.

item.title: Thunderstorms threaten South Africa special voting
item.description: Severe weather warnings issued for parts of Gauteng and Free State for November 2 and 3.

item.title: South African firm equips Zim school lab
item.description: Afribiz Invest partnered with Zodwa Mkandla Foundation to build a science facility at Sojini Secondary School.

item.title: South Africa launches new insecticide for potato moths
item.description: Syngenta’s SILVALIS®, powered by PLINAZOLIN® technology, offers a new mode of action for crop protection.

item.title: MK parliamentarian faces sanction over farm attack post
item.description: Andile Mngxitama's social media comments on a farm attack prompt calls for investigation by the SAHRC and parliament's ethics committee.

item.title: Jacob Zuma reaffirms ANC loyalty at MK party rally
item.description: Former president Jacob Zuma addressed thousands of supporters at the MK party's final election rally in Durban on Sunday.
